description: GET /api/v1/management/me with the `orgonly` key (no workspace permissions, organization access read and write).

body.message: This endpoint only supports API keys that are scoped to a single workspace. Use GET /api/v2/me to inspect organization-level API keys or keys with access to multiple workspaces.
